name: Tanzania
famous_for: Mount Kilimanjaro (highest peak in Africa, 5,895m), Serengeti Great Migration, Ngorongoro Crater, and Zanzibar spice island beaches.
tourists: Over 1.8M safari and beach visitors; famous for Serengeti lions, Kilimanjaro climbs, Stone Town Zanzibar, and Mafia Island whale sharks.
must_know: 'Pole Pole' (slowly, slowly) is the universal Swahili mantra, especially emphasized when climbing the high altitudes of Kilimanjaro.
fun_fact: The Ngorongoro Crater is the world's largest intact, unflooded volcanic caldera, forming a self-contained sanctuary for 25,000 large animals.
